excerpt: Canada Creates a New PR Pathway for Doctors By Anuj Sengar, Licensed RCIC R515178 · Founder, Can X GlobalPublished: February 2026 · 5 min read If you are applying for permanent residence through Express Entry, completing an Immigration Medical Exam (IME) is no longer optional or something you can wait for IRCC to request later. As of August 21, 2025, an upfront Immigration Medical Exam (IME) is mandatory for all Express Entry permanent residence applications.
